about: How exact each pin's map point is, for the Area check radius count. Kept apart from the hand-checked pin files so those files and the locked Sprint 5 predictions stay untouched. uncertainty_m is how far, at most, the real place can plausibly be from the pin. A pin counts as inside a circle only when its whole uncertainty fits inside; if only part of it overlaps, it counts as 'may be inside'. Every active pin needs an entry here or tools/publish.py stops.

levels.spot: A named spot (a school, a corner, a set distance from a landmark).
levels.street: Somewhere on a named street; the pin is on that street.
levels.area: A general point for a named part of a suburb or township.
levels.suburb: The suburb's own map point; the street is not mapped.
levels.town: The town's map point; the place itself may be outside the town.
levels.farm: A farm or farm-area point; the farm may not be exactly here.
levels.precinct: An estimated point for the police precinct that handled the case, used only when the place itself could not be put on a map. The pin is a reference (usually the station), not the scene; the uncertainty covers the whole precinct.
